# 调查报告：CrowdStrike global IT outage on July 19, 2024

> **覆盖率** 15/15 适用槽位（100%）　**事实** 23 条　**结论级双源支持** 4/23　**来源 episode** 19 个

> 本报告仅消费图谱证据包。每条结论都标注了来源 episode；无证据的槽位如实标记为未查到，不做推断补全。

## WHO

**Primary Actor**
  - a faulty software update re-leased by CrowdStrike `f5630fbd` `99b227c4`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly
  来源：[(PDF) CrowdStrike Causes Global Microsoft Outage: A Case Study](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/393170974_CrowdStrike_Causes_Global_Microsoft_Outage_A_Case_Study)、[[PDF] an outage strikes: assessing the global impact of crowdstrike's faulty ...](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CHRG-118hhrg60030/pdf/CHRG-118hhrg60030.pdf)

**Affected Parties**
  - Computers running macOS and Linux were unaffected, as the problematic content file was only for Windows `9fc99f05`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  - The impact to companies in the Central United States was exacerbated by an unrelated outage with Microsoft Azure the previous day. `9fc99f05`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  来源：[2024 CrowdStrike-related IT outages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_CrowdStrike-related_IT_outages)

**Related Organizations**
  - As it happens, ProcessUnity has a solution. And we’re already seeing how our customers use our platform to identify and assess the potential impact of this CrowdStrike incident. `2ac19818`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration；slot relevance is uncertain
  - Early Friday morning, a software update from CrowdStrike caused a massive IT outage worldwide. `2ac19818`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  - The issue impacted Microsoft Windows machines running Falcon sensor for Windows version 7.11. `2ac19818`
    ⚠️ no verified date: this source did not state one explicitly；single source; no claim-level corroboration
  来源：[July 19, 2024 - The CrowdStrike Incident](https://www.processunity.com/resources/blogs/the-crowdstrike-incident)

**Regulators**
  - CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. has revealed that it’s cooperating with ongoing U.S. federal investigations into its July 2024 outage that disrupted computer systems worldwide. `a9540b07`
    ⚠️ single source; no claim-level corroboration
  - CrowdStrike also disclosed in the filing that it has received inquiries from other government agencies and third parties regarding the outage `a9540b07`
